name: Resistant Scales
body:
You can weather your element far better than most.

Prerequisite(s): Draconic resistance racial trait, character level 7th.

Benefit(s): Your resistance to your element increases to resist 10.

Legendary Races: Wyrmtouched © 2018, Legendary Games; Authors: N. Jolly, Amber Underwood, Siobhan Bjorknas, and Loren Sieg.
